ohtani.title: Glasnow spins seven one-run frames to charge win
ohtani.blurb: Tyler Glasnow tosses seven one-run innings to boost the Dodgers to a 6-1 win over the Tigers

imanaga.title: Héctor Rodríguez hits a three-run homer in Reds' win
imanaga.blurb: Héctor Rodríguez hits a three-run homer along with three other Reds in their 7-5 win over the Cubs

suzuki.title: Alex Bregman homers three times in Cubs 17-3 win
suzuki.blurb: The Cubs crush a franchise record nine home runs, including Bregman going yard three times, to propel them to a 17-3 win over the Brewers

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Max Scherzer moves into 9th on K list in shutout win
okamoto.blurb: Max Scherzer strikes out 10 over seven scoreless innings, passing Gaylord Perry on the all-time list and leading Toronto to a 7-0 win

murakami.title: Velázquez, Smith lead Astros to 6-3 win vs. White Sox
murakami.blurb: Nelson Velázquez belts a two-run home run and Cam Smith hits a two-run double in the Astros' 6-3 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: DeLuca, Mateo lead Rays in 5-4 comeback win
matsui.blurb: Jonny DeLuca delivers a pair of game-tying hits and Jorge Mateo walks it off in the Rays' 5-4 comeback win over the Padres
